retention_tricks: Fast-Paced Editing: Quick cuts, rapid scene changes, no dead air.
Pattern Interrupts: Sudden sound effects, visual changes, or text pop-ups to re-engage attention.
Open Loops/Cliffhangers: Hinting at future information or a reveal, delaying the punchline.
Subtle Looping: Crafting the end to flow seamlessly back to the beginning for re-watches.
On-Screen Text: Reinforcing key points or adding context, useful for sound-off viewing.
Direct Address: Maintaining eye contact and speaking directly to the viewer.
